cards.back: documentación técnica y científica. / technical and scientific documentation.

cards.back: es decir, / i.e.,

cards.back: estás, / you are,

cards.back: por supuesto, / of course,

cards.back: invitado a apoyar / invited to support

cards.back: También puedes / You can also

cards.back: patrocinar el trabajo de / sponsor the work of

cards.back: miembros del equipo LaTeX / LaTeX team members
cards.explanation: This noun phrase refers to the individuals who are part of the team working on the LaTeX project. 'Team members' are people working together.

cards.back: a través del programa de patrocinio de GitHub / through the GitHub sponsor program
cards.explanation: 'Through the GitHub sponsor program' specifies the platform and method used for sponsoring. 'Through' indicates the means by which something is accomplished.

cards.back: en este momento / at the moment

cards.back: va sin ninguna reducción / goes without any reductions

cards.back: por GitHub / by GitHub
cards.explanation: 'By GitHub' indicates the agent or entity performing the action (or in this case, not performing reductions). 'By' shows who is responsible.

cards.back: a los desarrolladores / to the developers
cards.explanation: 'To the developers' specifies the recipients of the contribution. 'Developers' are the people who create software.

cards.back: en apoyo de / in support of

cards.back: el proyecto. / the project.

sourceText:
LaTeX is a high-quality typesetting system; it includes features designed for the production of technical and scientific documentation. LaTeX is the de facto standard for the communication and publication of scientific documents. LaTeX is available as free software.

You don't have to pay for using LaTeX, i.e., there are no license fees, etc. But you are, of course, invited to support the maintenance and development efforts through a donation to the TeX Users Group (choose LaTeX Project contribution) if you are satisfied with LaTeX.

You can also sponsor the work of LaTeX team members through the GitHub sponsor program at the moment for Frank, David and Joseph. Your contribution goes without any reductions by GitHub to the developers in support of the project.
